purpose: Prevent correlated bear-market trades and whole-DEV50 model selection from masquerading as independent validation.

stock_outer_folds.procedure: for each fold evolve only on other 4 folds; freeze fold winner/frontier before scoring omitted fold

episode_outer_folds.procedure: for each bear evolve only on other 5 bears; freeze fold winner/frontier before scoring omitted bear

training_fitness.primary_units: date clusters and bear episodes, not raw ticker-event count
training_fitness.same_date_rule: selected events sharing an entry date are first aggregated cross-sectionally; ticker multiplicity does not multiply fitness credit
training_fitness.episode_rule: episode contributions receive equal high-level weight; long GFC/2022 samples cannot dominate solely through event count
training_fitness.portfolio_accounting: exact daily mark-to-market with frozen cost/capacity assumptions
training_fitness.raw_event_count: activity diagnostic/constraint only, never independent-success count

selection_rule.principle: prefer chromosomes/families that recur or remain economically positive across independently trained outer folds
selection_rule.no_single_pooled_champion: a chromosome discovered once on pooled DEV50 cannot qualify by pooled fitness alone
selection_rule.no_answer_key_tuning: preserved50/TEST17 outcomes cannot set thresholds or choose chromosome parameters

candidate_layer: Upstream per-ticker computational candidate generation is recognized as an optimization layer. Nested GA results must report dependence on candidate family/horizon and candidate density; a later architecture may require candidate-layer nesting if instability remains.

verification_sequence.step1: complete all DEV50 nested folds and freeze final architecture/candidates/acceptance rule
verification_sequence.step2: one frozen replay on preserved50; no mutation
verification_sequence.step3: if predeclared verification gate passes, one frozen replay on TEST17; no mutation
verification_sequence.failure: retain failure; do not repair against verification/test
